verdict.rationale: Clara's own evidence of event-triggered automation is narrow: cards can be configured to auto-delete when a trip period ends (enableAutoDeletion with an endDate), card configurations enforce time, day-of-week and merchant restrictions, and the marketing site claims 'automated expense reporting, approvals and compliance'. Webhook subscriptions only deliver events to the user's own endpoint, so any resulting action has to be built by the developer and earns no credit as a rules engine. Missing for 10: a documented user-definable rule engine (event → condition → action), rules covering transaction or approval events beyond card expiry, documentation of how automated approvals are configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
